title: Action
description: An action that can be triggered by a component interaction

type.description: The action type from the closed catalog (ADR-002)

to.description: Target route name for NAVIGATE. Must match a route in the client registry (ADR-003)

endpoint.description: Relative endpoint path for SUBMIT actions (e.g. '/transfers')

fieldKeys.description: List of fieldKey values to collect from local state and send in the SUBMIT body

toggleKey.description: Identifier for the local state entry to toggle in LOCAL_TOGGLE actions

message.description: Message text to display for SHOW_TOAST actions

modalId.description: Identifier for the modal to open in OPEN_MODAL actions (reserved for future use)
